framework.name: IEC 62443 Industrial Communication Networks - Network and System Security
framework.description: Comprehensive OT/ICS cybersecurity standard covering Security Programs for Asset Owners (2-1), OT Patch Management (2-3), Service Providers (2-4), and System Security Requirements (3-3) across 7 Foundational Requirements (FR1–FR7) and Security Levels SL1–SL4.
framework.author: International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) / ISA

controls.title: IACS Information Security Policy
controls.description: Establish, document, and maintain an operational technology (OT) information security policy aligned with business objectives.

controls.title: IACS Security Risk Assessment
controls.description: Conduct periodic cybersecurity risk assessments specifically evaluating potential impacts on physical safety, environmental protection, and operational continuity.
evidence_checklist: Threat matrix for physical safety impacts

controls.title: IACS Asset Inventory and Classification
controls.description: Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all IACS components, PLCs, HMIs, network devices, and software assets categorized by Purdue Model levels.
evidence_checklist: MAC/IP address mapping to Purdue level

controls.title: OT Security Personnel Training and Awareness
controls.description: Ensure control room operators, field engineers, and maintenance contractors receive role-specific OT cybersecurity training.

controls.title: IACS Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
controls.description: Develop and regularly test business continuity and disaster recovery plans designed to restore critical process automation following severe cyber incidents.
evidence_checklist: PLC logic backup restoration test logs

controls.title: IACS Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Maintain an incident response plan specifically addressing physical safety protocols, plant emergency shutdown triggers, and containment of OT threats.
evidence_checklist: Tabletop drill records for SCADA ransomware

controls.title: Physical Security of Control Rooms and Cabinets
controls.description: Enforce physical access controls for control rooms, field equipment rooms, Marshalling cabinets, and remote terminal unit (RTU) enclosures.
evidence_checklist: Keycard access logs for Control Rooms
CCTV coverage diagram for PLC cabinets

controls.title: Independent IACS Security Audit
controls.description: Perform independent periodic security audits of the industrial control system network, configurations, and governance procedures.

controls.title: OEM Vendor Patch Validation and Qualification
controls.description: Verify that all software, OS, and firmware patches are formally validated by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) prior to installation on live IACS components.

controls.title: Maintenance Window Patch Deployment Protocol
controls.description: Schedule patch deployments strictly during designated plant turnaround or maintenance outage windows with rollback procedures established.
evidence_checklist: Approved Change Request for OT patching

controls.title: Firmware and Logic Hash Integrity Verification
controls.description: Verify cryptographic digital signatures and cryptographic hashes of PLC firmware updates and SCADA software installers before flashing controllers.

controls.title: Emergency Out-of-Band Vulnerability Mitigation
controls.description: Establish compensating controls (such as firewall isolation or protocol blocking) when critical zero-day vulnerabilities cannot be patched immediately.

controls.title: Legacy Controller Isolation for End-of-Life Assets
controls.description: Isolate legacy controllers or operating systems (such as Windows XP/7 or unpatchable PLCs) using dedicated conduit firewalls and unidirectional gateways.
evidence_checklist: Legacy asset isolation firewall ACL export

controls.title: Service Provider Remote Access Security Protocol
controls.description: Enforce strict multi-factor authentication, session recording, and time-bound approval for third-party system integrator remote maintenance sessions.
controls.scan_module_hint: OT Jump Host / RDP Config Check
evidence_checklist: MFA enforcement policy on OT Jump Box

controls.title: Vendor Portable Laptop and USB Media Sanitization
controls.description: Require field service engineers to scan vendor laptops and USB drives for malware at a dedicated kiosk before connecting to control room networks.

controls.title: Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) Cyber Validation
controls.description: Include security verification (port audits, default credential checks, hardcoded key removal) during Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) prior to site delivery.

controls.title: Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) Commissioning Audit
controls.description: Perform complete cybersecurity commissioning checks during Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) before integrating new equipment into operational zones.

controls.title: Supply Chain Component Traceability and BOM
controls.description: Obtain a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and hardware origin traceability records for critical industrial automation components.

controls.title: Integrator Offboarding and Credential Revocation
controls.description: Immediately revoke third-party contractor access credentials, VPN profiles, and active SSH keys upon contract completion or personnel change.

controls.title: Human user identification and authentication
controls.description: Identify and authenticate all human users on the IACS before granting access.
controls.scan_module_hint: Active Directory / Local User Account Scan

controls.title: Human User Unique Identification (SL2 Enhancement)
controls.description: Ensure human users are uniquely identified and authenticated, strictly prohibiting shared or generic operator logins.
evidence_checklist: SCADA user roster without generic accounts

controls.title: MFA for Untrusted Networks (SL3/SL4 Enhancement)
controls.description: Employ multi-factor authentication mechanisms for human access to the IACS across untrusted network boundaries or DMZ jump hosts.
controls.scan_module_hint: OT Jump Host MFA Policy Check
evidence_checklist: DUO/Radius MFA policy export for OT DMZ

controls.title: Software process and device identification
controls.description: Identify and authenticate automated processes, SCADA scripts, and external devices connecting to the IACS network.
evidence_checklist: X.509 device certificate list for OPC UA

controls.title: Account management and lifecycle enforcement
controls.description: Manage IACS user accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, disabling, and removing accounts in accordance with least privilege.

controls.title: Authenticator management and credential storage
controls.description: Store and manage authenticators (passwords, keys, tokens) securely, enforcing strong hashing and preventing plaintext credential storage.
evidence_checklist: OS SAM / Shadow file password hash config

controls.title: Strength of password-based authentication
controls.description: Enforce password complexity standards (minimum length, special characters) suitable for OT operational environments without impairing emergency access.

controls.title: Unsuccessful login attempts and account lockout
controls.description: Lock IACS user accounts after a predefined number of consecutive invalid logon attempts to prevent brute-force attacks.
evidence_checklist: Account Lockout Policy threshold config (e.g. 5 failed attempts)

controls.title: Authorization enforcement and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.description: Enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to restrict user access rights based on job roles (Operator, Engineer, Maintenance, Administrator).

controls.title: Authorization Enforcement for Dual Approval (SL3 Enhancement)
controls.description: Require dual authorization (four-eyes principle) for high-risk operations such as safety threshold overrides or PLC logic updates.
evidence_checklist: Dual authorization log for safety interlock bypass

controls.title: Use of unsecure legacy industrial protocols
controls.description: Restrict or eliminate unencrypted legacy industrial protocols (Telnet, HTTP, Modbus TCP without TLS) across control zone boundaries.

controls.title: Mobile code execution restriction
controls.description: Restrict the execution of unverified mobile code, active scripts, and unsigned macros on engineering workstations and HMIs.

controls.title: Concurrent session control
controls.description: Limit the maximum number of concurrent sessions per user account across HMIs and remote engineering jump boxes.
evidence_checklist: Group Policy Max Concurrent RDP Sessions config

controls.title: Session lock and inactivity timeout
controls.description: Automatically lock HMI displays and engineering terminals after a maximum of 15 minutes of inactivity.
evidence_checklist: Group Policy Screen Saver Lock settings

controls.title: Remote session termination
controls.description: Terminate remote maintenance sessions automatically upon inactivity or contract window expiration.
evidence_checklist: VPN session timeout setting (e.g. 60 min max)

controls.title: Emergency override and breakout procedure (Break-Glass)
controls.description: Establish audited break-glass emergency override accounts for plant operations during severe network or Active Directory outages.
evidence_checklist: Sealed envelope break-glass key vault log

controls.title: Communication integrity and anti-tampering
controls.description: Protect control system network communications from tampering, packet injection, and unauthorized replay attacks.

controls.title: Protection against malicious code (Antivirus / EDR)
controls.description: Deploy anti-malware and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents tailored for industrial control applications on all HMIs and SCADA nodes.

controls.title: Security functionality verification and diagnostic checks
controls.description: Perform automated self-tests and diagnostic health checks of security controls on critical safety controllers and HMIs.

controls.title: Software and information integrity (File Integrity Monitoring)
controls.description: Deploy File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) to detect unauthorized changes to SCADA project files, PLC logic binaries, and system DLLs.
evidence_checklist: Tripwire/Wazuh FIM policy rules for SCADA project dir

controls.title: Input data validation for control commands
controls.description: Validate input data parameters and boundary conditions on HMI interfaces to prevent buffer overflows or malformed command execution.

controls.title: Application execution prevention (Whitelisting)
controls.description: Enforce application whitelisting (AppLocker / WDAC) on HMIs and Engineering Workstations to block unauthorized executable execution.
evidence_checklist: AppLocker rule XML export in Enforce Mode

controls.title: Audit log generation and tamper protection
controls.description: Generate security audit logs for all operator actions, setpoint changes, logins, and system events, storing logs immutably.
evidence_checklist: Syslog forwarding configuration to OT SIEM
Windows Event Log Audit Policy export

controls.title: Information confidentiality for OT data in transit
controls.description: Protect confidential operational data (recipes, formulas, plant telemetry, network diagrams) in transit across external or untrusted conduits.

controls.title: Information confidentiality for OT data at rest
controls.description: Encrypt sensitive data at rest on historians, engineering workstations, and portable backup drives using strong AES encryption.
evidence_checklist: BitLocker / LUKS status export on Historian

controls.title: Use of cryptography and strong cipher suites
controls.description: Enforce approved cryptographic algorithms (AES-256, RSA-3072, SHA-256) and disable deprecated ciphers (RC4, 3DES, SSLv3).

controls.title: Cryptographic key management and protection
controls.description: Establish lifecycle management for cryptographic keys and SSL/TLS certificates used within the IACS network.
evidence_checklist: Internal OT PKI Certificate Authority inventory

controls.title: Sanitization of decommissioned OT hardware media
controls.description: Sanitize or physically destroy decommissioned hard drives, PLC memory cards, and flash drives prior to disposal.

controls.title: Network segmentation & Zone/Conduit control
controls.description: Segment the IACS into security zones and establish conduits to control communications across zone boundaries.
controls.scan_module_hint: Firewall Rule Parser / Purdue Model Boundary Check
evidence_checklist: OT Firewall rulebase export (Level 3 to Level 2 DMZ filtering)

controls.title: Stateful Packet Inspection Conduits (SL2 Enhancement)
controls.description: Enforce stateful packet inspection (SPI) and protocol-aware filtering on all conduits connecting control zones.

controls.title: Zone boundary protection and DMZ architecture
controls.description: Prohibit direct network connections between the Enterprise IT network (Level 4/5) and the IACS Control Zone (Level 1/2), requiring an OT DMZ (Level 3.5).

controls.title: General purpose network isolation
controls.description: Isolate general-purpose corporate networks (email, web browsing) from IACS operational control networks.

controls.title: Unidirectional data diodes for critical safety zones
controls.description: Deploy hardware-enforced unidirectional gateways (data diodes) for data egress from critical Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS) to upper layers.

controls.title: Audit log monitoring and intrusion detection (OT IDS)
controls.description: Deploy Industrial Intrusion Detection Systems (OT IDS / Passive Traffic Monitors like Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi) to detect abnormal protocol commands.
evidence_checklist: SPAN port / network TAP config export

controls.title: Continuous security monitoring and alert triage
controls.description: Establish 24/7 security monitoring and alert triage protocols for critical SCADA alarms and unauthorized configuration changes.

controls.title: Time synchronization via authenticated NTP
controls.description: Synchronize clocks across all IACS devices, PLCs, RTUs, and historians using authenticated Network Time Protocol (NTP) servers.

controls.title: Forensic evidence collection capability
controls.description: Preserve memory snapshots, PLC logic files, and packet captures following suspected OT security breaches.

controls.title: Automated incident escalation triggers
controls.description: Configure automated high-priority alerts to OT plant managers when critical safety interlocks or SCADA setpoints are modified.

controls.title: Denial of service protection for control networks
controls.description: Protect IACS control networks and components against network flooding, broadcast storms, and Resource Exhaustion (DoS) attacks.
evidence_checklist: OT Switch Storm Control ACL settings

controls.title: Resource management and memory protection
controls.description: Limit resource consumption on HMIs and historians to prevent memory leaks or process exhaustion from crashing critical monitoring services.

controls.title: Control system backup and restore capability
controls.description: Maintain offline, immutable backups of PLC ladder logic, HMI project files, historian databases, and switch configurations.

controls.title: Network and device redundancy (High Availability)
controls.description: Deploy redundant communication paths (PRP/HSR, RSTP) and redundant power supplies for critical SCADA servers and OT switches.

controls.title: Control system fail-safe and fail-secure mode
controls.description: Ensure controllers automatically revert to a safe state (Fail-Safe) or maintain safety interlocks upon loss of network connectivity.
evidence_checklist: Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) proof test certificate
